summary: structured completion candidates for the next word (the TUI/agent completion contract)
hints: The completion contract: given the words already typed after `ops`, emit the candidates for the NEXT word as structured rows {value, description, kind} — kind is verb|action|enum|<provider> (note-slug|task-id|hub|note-type|status|layer). Same brain as zsh tab-completion (`ops __complete`), derived live from each verb's cmd.json actions[]/args (no hardcoded tables). Use --json for the machine rows; without it, one `value  description` per line. Common mistake: passing the word being completed — pass only the words BEFORE it (e.g. `ops complete task move` lists statuses).
